newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Hong Kong Telecom cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hong Kong Telecom cut.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan said on Monday it downgraded its rating for Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd to market performer from buy.
-- The company "reported net profit for the first half of fiscal 1997 up 12.1 percent ... but below our estimate of projected growth of 14 percent," analyst David Barden wrote in a report.
-- He revised downward earnings estimates for 1997 and 1998 by two percent.

-- The company's "current estimated price/earnings ratio and forecast 10.3 percent five-year average earnings per share growth place the shares in a fair valuation range relative to other Hong Kong utilities," Barden wrote.
-- "Regionally, HKT trades as the most attractive developed telecommunications operator, but not significantly below the average valuation for all companies on most measures."
-- The company's American Depositary Receipt was down 1/8 to 16-7/8 in late-afternoon New York trade.
